Name: Iridium Chef
Author: Tulaash
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/od4R2kg.png[/img]﻿

I have a blast cooking in the game, and love looking for cooking recipe mods to add even more, mostly to extend my playtime and make perfection harder, so I thought - why not make my own mod with some recipes of my own, especially of foods I personally love in real life? This mod features over 40 brand new recipes to cook, with various ways of getting them (some easier than others!) Some of the art in this mod is created by me, some of it is recolors of official sprites, and some are reused from other parts in the game!

Here is a list of everything the mod adds:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1oMtdElLYYyxLrdEm1WWOCYpGwN1ySB0ZFI-Q_IIiGb8/edit?usp=sharing

[img]https://i.imgur.com/518DflS.png[/img]﻿[/center][center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][/url]﻿1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI
[/url]﻿2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url],﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry
[/url]﻿3. Install Iridium Chef
4. Make sure you enable all three of Cornucopia's crop packs (Extended Crops, Extended Trees, and Herbs)
5. You are ready to go!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3ZbXbCq.png[/img]﻿

Tulaash [[url=https://ko-fi.com/tulaash]Ko-Fi[/url]﻿]
